subject: Medford High School Project Funding Strategy
overview: The committee recommended funding for the Osgood House restoration and Playstead scoreboard contingency while establishing a subcommittee to evaluate long-term CPA support for the Medford High School construction project.

items.title: Osgood House Restoration Funding
items.summary: Approved a recommendation for $10,000 to the Unitarian Universalist Church for exterior repairs and the installation of fiberglass gutters at the historic Osgood House.

items.title: Playstead Digital Scoreboard Contingency
items.summary: Approved $32,000 in additional contingency funding for the digital scoreboard at Playstead Park after project bids exceeded the initial allocation.

items.title: Medford High School Project Introduction
items.summary: Discussed potential CPA funding for non-reimbursable elements of the high school building project, such as playgrounds, grass fields, and site trees. The committee agreed to form a subcommittee to develop a specific funding and bonding strategy for the multi-year project.

items.title: Administrative Updates and Potential Project List
items.summary: Reviewed a list of approximately $3.4 million in preliminary project requests for the upcoming cycle, including City Hall limestone restoration, firehouse repairs, and park improvements.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the June 9 meeting.
